title: 第13章 火影七日游
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
那就是“异世界化身交流”！
也就是关立远所说的“穿越”，不过与真正的穿越，还是有很大区别的。
从本质上来说，是利用“论坛币”转化的力量，在对应的“异世界”形成一个化身，该化身最大程度的兼顾使用者的身体属性与所拜访的“异世界”的宇宙规则！
简单地说，化身不会拥有所拜访宇宙规则之外的力量……
比如一名传奇法师，如果要拜访一个0神秘度的纯科技宇宙，就只能形成一个“非常健康的普通人”的化身。
反过来一个科技宇宙的会员，拜访魔法宇宙的话，则会有一具“魔法天赋极高”的化身，可以在对方的世界学习魔法，但是因为世界规则不支持、带不回自己的世界……
而如果是两个相近的魔法世界，传奇法师可以形成魔导士、准传奇级的化身，而且在另一个魔法世界的所得，很大一部分也能够在自己的世界使用！
对于关立远来说，只有与“主世界”的规则有重合部分、能够提升自己在“主世界”的能力的宇宙才有价值！
在开灵仪式之后，企鹅就帮关立远分析了，可能与他的职业能力有重合规则的世界。
而这些世界，并不是关立远想去就去……
虽然作为管理员，“论坛币”就可以免了，相当于是使用从其他会员那赚来的“结余”，但是“邀请制”的规则却不能免除！
也就是必须对应世界的会员，邀请关立远前往，他才能够“穿越”。
不过作为管理员的特权是，只要关立远被邀请一次，之后就可以无限次的“穿越”对应的世界。
关立远看过了企鹅提供给自己的世界名单，其中大部分都是“老会员”，一个个不是一方大佬、就是归隐幕后的绝世人物……
而关立远这个“真·主角”的ID，前几天还被人按在地上biu，突然就能够承担“异世界化身交流”的高消费，显然会令人怀疑！
“论坛币”的获取没有窍门，可以说是一种世界力量的转化，比如在无神秘度宇宙的贵金属，与魔法世界的魔能水晶，拥有的兑换比例是相近的。
也就是说拥有更多论坛币的会员，无论他在哪种宇宙，都说明其身份显赫！
当然，即便被怀疑其实也没什么，最多是在八卦板块发几个“造谣帖”，但是关立远不想管理员身份暴露、也不想其他会员防备自己，毕竟这关系到自己有没有机会穿越过去……
万幸的是，关立远发现这些世界的会员中，有一个明显读的书少、很容易骗的！
那就是“将成为火影的男人”……

心中渴求他人关注的“将成为火影的男人”，一开始就是关立远的“攻略”重点，四个月以来，两人已经成为了随时可以见面程度的“网友”！
关立远相信只要自己开口，对方绝对会邀请自己的，不过因为关立远还需要一个“时间调节”的插件，所以又耽搁了几天。
这是论坛拥有主世界后才有的功能，可以控制主世界与其他世界的时间比例，否则关立远当几天植物人的话，肯定会引出乱子……
【七天？七天有什么用？让我满足一下情怀？】
关立远当时一副很失望的样子，但是两天后，还是很兴奋的和“将成为火影的男人”……好吧，其实就是和“漩涡鸣人”说起了邀请的事情，和这货私聊了不到两个小时，他就把真名透露给关立远了！
【立远要来看我吗？当然可以了！我太高兴了……刚好我在进行一个离开村子的任务，我这就发出邀请！】
果然，还是鸣人傻白甜，比那些老油条好唬弄多了。
如果他是个女的，四个月的网聊，够关立远税他六次的……
【嗯？你已经能接离开村子的任务了？也好……免得还要藏起来。】
关立远躺到了床上，对企鹅再三确认时间调节插件已经设置好了之后，便开启了“异世界化身交流”的功能！
【放心吧！这次可以在对方的世界停留七天，主世界时间流逝三个小时。】
关立远的意识一阵模糊，再次睁开眼睛的时候，发现一名脸上有着六道胡须样的痕迹的小黄毛，正兴致勃勃的看着自己……
而现在自己正躺在一处森林的草地上。
看来这家伙还没傻透，知道找个没人的地方……
“立远！原来你是长得这副样子的，很照片上一样啊！”

content_en:
That's "Incarnation Communication from Another World"!
This is what Guan Liyuan calls "travel", but it is still very different from real time travel.
In essence, it uses the power of "Forum Coin" transformation to form an avatar in the corresponding "different world". This avatar takes into account the physical attributes of the user and the cosmic rules of the "different world" visited to the greatest extent!
Simply put, the avatar does not possess powers outside of the rules of the universe it visits...
For example, if a legendary mage wants to visit a purely technological universe with 0 mystery, he can only form the incarnation of a "very healthy ordinary person".
On the other hand, if a member of the technological universe visits the magical universe, he will have an incarnation with "extremely high magical talent". He can learn magic in the other person's world, but because the world rules do not support it, he cannot take it back to his own world...
And if there are two similar magic worlds, the legendary mage can form a wizard, a quasi-legendary incarnation, and a large part of the income gained in the other magic world can also be used in his own world!
For Guan Liyuan, only universes that overlap with the rules of the "main world" and can improve his abilities in the "main world" are valuable!
After the spirit opening ceremony, Penguin helped Guan Liyuan analyze worlds that might have rules that overlapped with his professional abilities.
And these worlds are not something Guan Liyuan can go to whenever he wants...
Although as an administrator, "forum coins" can be waived, which is equivalent to using the "balance" earned from other members, the "invitation system" rules cannot be waived!
That is to say, a member of the corresponding world must invite Guan Liyuan there before he can "travel".
However, the privilege of being an administrator is that as long as Guan Liyuan is invited once, he can "travel" to the corresponding world an unlimited number of times.
Guan Liyuan has seen the list of worlds provided to him by Penguin. Most of them are "old members", each of whom is either a big boss or a peerless figure who has retired behind the scenes...
And the ID of Guan Liyuan, the "real protagonist", was pinned to the ground a few days ago and suddenly he can afford the high cost of "incarnation communication in another world", which is obviously suspicious!
There is no trick to obtain "Forum Coin". It can be said to be a transformation of world power. For example, the exchange ratio between precious metals in the unmysterious universe and magic crystals in the magical world is similar.
In other words, a member with more forum coins, no matter which universe he is in, means that he has a prominent status!
Of course, even if he is suspected, it is nothing. At most, he will post a few "rumor posts" in the gossip section, but Guan Liyuan does not want the identity of the administrator to be exposed, nor does he want other members to guard against him. After all, this is related to whether he has the opportunity to travel to the past...
Fortunately, Guan Liyuan discovered that among the members of these worlds, there was one who obviously read few books and was easily deceived!
That is "the man who will become Hokage"...
The "man who will become Hokage" who longs for the attention of others has been the focus of Guan Liyuan's "strategy" from the beginning. In the past four months, the two have become "net friends" who can meet at any time!
Guan Liyuan believed that as long as he opened his mouth, the other party would definitely invite him. However, because Guan Liyuan also needed a "time adjustment" plug-in, it was delayed for a few more days.
This is a function only available after the forum owns the main world. It can control the time ratio between the main world and other worlds. Otherwise, if Guan Liyuan is in a vegetative state for a few days, it will definitely cause trouble...
【Seven days? What's the use of seven days? Let me satisfy my feelings? 】
Guan Liyuan looked very disappointed at the time, but two days later, he was still very excited and talked to "the man who will become Hokage"...well, actually he talked about the invitation with "Uzumaki Naruto". After chatting privately with this guy for less than two hours, he revealed his real name to Guan Liyuan.Liyuan!
【Does Liyuan want to see me? Of course! I'm so happy... I happen to be on a mission to leave the village, so I'll send out an invitation! 】
Sure enough, Naruto was still silly and sweet, much easier to fool than those old fools.
If he was a woman, four months of online chatting would be enough to tax him six times...
【Huh? Are you able to take on the quest to leave the village? It's good...so as not to hide it anymore. 】
Guan Liyuan lay on the bed, and after repeatedly confirming with Penguin that the time adjustment plug-in had been set up, he turned on the "Incarnation Communication in Another World" function!
【Don’t worry! This time you can stay in the other person's world for seven days, and the time in the main world will pass for three hours. 】
Guan Liyuan's consciousness blurred for a while. When he opened his eyes again, he found a little yellow-haired man with six beard-like marks on his face, looking at him with interest...
And now he was lying on the grass in a forest.
It seems that this guy is not stupid enough to find a place where no one is around...
"Liyuan! So you look like this, exactly like the photo!"
